title: Cookie policy
intro: How SoccerOctopus uses cookies to provide a functioning service and remember your preferences.

what.title: 1. What are cookies
what.body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences, keep you signed in, and understand how people use the platform. SoccerOctopus uses a minimal set of cookies to provide a functioning service.

choices.title: 3. Your choices
choices.body: When you first visit SoccerOctopus you are shown a cookie banner. You can choose to accept all cookies, including analytics, or necessary only, covering authentication and consent storage only.
choices.resetHelp: You can withdraw or change your consent at any time by clearing your browser's local storage for this site, or by selecting the button below.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party cookies
thirdParty.body: Authentication is provided by an external authentication service, which may set cookies as part of the sign-in flow. These cookies are strictly necessary to operate the service. Contact us if you need more information about the authentication service's privacy practices.

browser.title: 5. Browser controls
browser.body: All major browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Note that blocking necessary cookies will prevent sign-in from working. Links to browser guidance:

contact.prefix: Questions about this policy can be directed to the SoccerOctopus team via the

session.purpose: Authentication: keeps you signed in and identifies your session securely.

consent.purpose: Stores your cookie consent choice so we do not show the banner again.

analytics.purpose: Google Analytics: helps us understand which pages are visited and how the swarm engine is used. Only set if you consent to analytics cookies.
